related.description: Jump quickly to directories that you have visited "frecently." A native Zsh port of z.sh with added features.
:rocket: Jump to custom directories in zsh
Zsh plugin that converts ..., ...., ....., etc., into cd commands to navigate parent directories.
Simplify zsh directory navigation; jump to already visited, parent or sub folders.
☣️ Shell plugin for zsh/bash that allows you to cd to subdirectories of user-defined directories from anywhere, without editing CDPATH.
